conceptZh: 有是擁有、存在，手裡抱著東西
object: a barrel-shaped toy pirate, his uncooperative parrot, and a treasure chest
morph: the pirate stacks a silly wrong shape of barrels, then fixes it into 有 with a swooping stroke on top of a moon-like frame holding treasure
creativeAngle: 海盜先得意地堆出一個歪歪的木桶塔，鸚鵡不領情；他聳肩一下改成「有」，月字框裡塞滿寶藏，詞用「沒有」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale seafoam backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 有, centered in saturated crimson strokes about 70 percent of frame height: a long left-falling stroke crossing a horizontal bar on top, over the open window frame 月 with its two inner short bars. Cast: Barnaby, a barrel-shaped toy pirate with a tiny eyepatch and a stripy sash, and Polly, a green parrot who flatly refuses to cooperate and keeps doing the opposite. Moment one, 0 to 1.8s: Barnaby waddles in rolling a small barrel, then rolls a second one, and stacks them into a leaning pyramid shaped like a lumpy tent with a plank stuck sideways on top. He folds his arms proudly. The first 有 is spoken as he beams. Moment two, 1.8 to 3.4s: Polly lands on the plank, it tips, and she hops off with a flat look; Barnaby tilts his head, sees the pyramid does not look like anything, glances at the empty outline, and shrugs. The second 有 is spoken as he snaps his fingers. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: in one quick move he flips the plank into a diagonal slash, the horizontal bar slides under it, and the barrels re-stack into the open frame of 月, each landing with a hollow thunk while Polly drops golden coins into the window and bats a coin away with her wing. Moment four, 5.0s onward: Barnaby opens a tiny treasure chest at the bottom and finds it overflowing with shiny round candies. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and uncovered while Barnaby hugs the chest and Polly, finally cooperative, flaps her wings in a small happy hop on his hat, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「有、有、沒有」, slowly with clear tones as ㄧㄡˇ、ㄧㄡˇ、ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ. First 有 near 0.7s, second near 2.4s, and 沒有 around 5.3s as the chest opens and Barnaby, then Polly, spread both empty paws. Stop after the word. Only soft wooden thunks, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 有.

conceptZh: 有就是「擁有」：大怪獸想要高台上那顆閃亮亮的蘋果，一轉身尾巴碰倒第一塊木板，一整排木板骨牌式倒下，剛好排成「有」，最後一塊把牠翹上天，蘋果落進牠手裡——牠終於「有」蘋果了。
object: a row of six tall crimson toy planks standing like dominoes, with one shiny red apple perched on the far last plank
morph: the monster's tail bumps plank one; each plank topples onto the next in stroke order and lands exactly in place: a slanted plank as the top left-falling stroke, a flat plank as the crossing bar, a gently curved plank as the left side of 月, a tall bent plank as the right side with its hook, and two short planks dropping inside as the two inner bars; the last plank flips the monster into the air
creativeAngle: 和前一版的海盜堆木桶完全不同：這次用骨牌連鎖反應，大怪獸「笨手笨腳一轉身就撞倒東西」的個性直接變成觸發器。六塊木板依「有」的筆順依序倒下、落定，落點清楚對應每一筆，小朋友看得到每一筆是怎麼來的。最後一塊木板像翹翹板把怪獸彈飛、蘋果落入手中，正好演出「有」＝擁有；發條鯊魚咬錯木板後在地上轉圈，剛好配合「有趣」這個詞。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale butter-yellow backdrop, locked camera, soft even studio light. The only text that ever appears is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 有, built from saturated crimson toy planks and finishing centered at about 70 percent of frame height with clear margins. Cast: Boomba, a huge round fuzzy teal cartoon monster with one stubby horn, a goofy gap-toothed grin, tiny arms and a big fluffy tail, who knocks things over just by turning around; and Snapper, a chunky orange wind-up toy shark with a clicking key that chomps at everything and always bites the wrong thing. Props: a row of six tall crimson planks standing upright like dominoes across the middle of the frame, each a different length and bend, and one shiny red apple perched on top of the far-right plank. Moment one, 0 to 1.5s: Boomba stands at the far left, stares at the apple, licks its lips, and points at it with both tiny arms, stomping happily in place. Snapper waddles in from the right, eyes the apple too, and chomps the air. Moment two, 1.5 to 3.0s: Boomba tiptoes along the planks in an exaggerated careful sneak, arms out, humming silently, and then turns around to shush Snapper. Its fluffy tail swings wide and taps the first plank with a tiny tock. Freeze for half a second: Boomba looks at its tail, eyes going wide, as the plank slowly tilts. Snapper lunges, bites the wrong plank, and bounces off. Moment three, 3.0 to 4.8s: the domino chain runs, faster and faster, each plank knocking the next with a wooden clack. Plank one falls leaning down-left and lands as the top left-falling stroke of 有; plank two drops flat across it as the horizontal bar; plank three lands slightly curved as the left side of 月; the tall bent plank four lands as the right side, its lower end hooking inward; the two short planks five and six tumble into the window as the two inner bars, top one first. Boomba is standing on the far end of plank six like a see-saw, so when it slams down Boomba is flung into the air with a squash-and-stretch somersault, lands with a soft fuzzy whump sitting below the glyph, and the apple plops straight into its paws. Moment four, 4.8 to 8.0s: the completed 有 holds perfectly still, fully visible and uncovered. Boomba hugs the apple, gives a surprised thumbs-up, then giggles and points as Snapper, who bit plank four's edge too late, spins in slow dizzy circles on dry land beside the frame, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「有、有、有趣」, read slowly and distinctly with clear tones as ㄧㄡˇ、ㄧㄡˇ、ㄧㄡˇ ㄑㄩˋ. First 有 near 0.8s as Boomba points at the apple it wants; second 有 near 4.4s as the last two planks click into the window and the glyph completes; 有趣 near 5.8s as Boomba giggles and points at the spinning shark while holding its apple. Stop after the word, no other dialogue. Only soft wooden clacks, one fuzzy whump and a tiny wind-up tick, no background music. Bright but not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 有.
